test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In Pradhan Mantri Gramin DISHA (PMGDISHA) Programme, DISHA stands for:

options.text: Development Interior Skiksha Help and Assistance

solution:
The correct answer is **__Digital Saksharta Abhiyan.__**

__
 
• **DISHA stands for Digital Saksharta Abhiyan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **P****radhan **Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)(2016-17)

 
 
• The goal of the scheme is to make at least one person digitally literate in each family.
 
• There are four pillars of literacy in the modern age-Reading, writing, arithmetic and digital literacy.
 
• (PMGDISHA) focused on the fourth pillar i.e. digital literacy
 
• It is one of the largest digital literacy programs all over the world.
 
• initiated under Digital India Program would cover 6crore households in rural areas to make them digitally literate. Under it, The marginalized sections of society like SCs/STs, minorities, BPL families, and differently-abled will be a part of this scheme.
 
• Scheme format - Twenty hours of digital training is provided free of cost to rural persons in the age group of 14 to 60 years,People will be trained to operate tablets, computers, and smartphones.
